_comment: Each run writes TWO files into the Drive folder below via the Drive connector's create_file: (1) a narrative Google Doc — contentMimeType 'text/plain' with a markdown body, which Drive auto-converts to a native Google Doc; and (2) a companion item-log Google Sheet — contentMimeType 'text/csv', which auto-converts to a native Sheet. IMPORTANT: 'text/html' does NOT convert (stays a raw file) — do not use it (proven by the sibling skills). CSV-escape every Sheet field: wrap each in double quotes and double any internal quotes, because headlines and 'why it matters' routinely contain commas. Recommend/draft-only — nothing is published, posted, or emailed. Last resort if the connector is unavailable: write a local .md (the Doc) and .csv (the Sheet) to the working directory.
_driveFolderNote: Create a dedicated 'News Roundup' Drive folder and paste its ID here, OR reuse the SEO Content Pipeline folder (1S0N1wmOmlO-NySg9TiIvs_TGkCG7Vlam). Until a real ID is set, the skill falls back to local .md + .csv files.
dataFreshnessNote: Web items dated from WebFetch (not the search snippet); Ahrefs brand-radar/social/Site-Explorer are fresh; the GSC feed lags ~Dec 2025 and is not used here.
